text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's already dark, but I can still hear noise coming from the dance studio.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aaaughhh! I just can't get these steps right.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It looks so sharp and cool when Opera O does it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Judging from Vodka's movements, it looks like she's only concentrating on her upper body.
choice_data_list: I think you're too focused on your upper body.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ack!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Oh, Trainer. Don't freak me out like that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, I'm too focused on my upper body?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Isn't dancing all about your facial expressions and arm movements?
choice_data_list: You've gotta nail the foundation first.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's right! It's just like how if you keep topplin' your motorcycle, it means you needa work on your footing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Which means… if my lower half isn't sturdy, I can't nail the routine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey! You got any good lower body exercises for me?
choice_data_list: How about using a stationary bike?
Long-distance running is probably the best way.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A stationary bike? Oh, you mean those bikes at the gym?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How's that any different from ridin' a regular bike? Are they really gonna help?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka doesn't seem keen on the idea, but the next morning…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear a voice coming from the gym.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Vrrrroom vroooom!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Here we go! I'll show ya the thrill of my full-throttle cornering technique!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, think ya can keep up with that kind of half-assed effort?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Augh! Wh-what're you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ju-just sayin', but you're the one who told me ride the stationary bike! Got it?
choice_data_list: Maybe, but the "vroom" noises were all you…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Scuse me?! Ya sure you're not just hearin' things?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You know what? If you're just gonna get in the way of my training, get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Geez! Can't even let my guard down for a second. Now where was I?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now, back to drifting the cliffside!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Hey! What're you lookin' at?! I-I thought I told ya to get out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm burning to know how Vodka's gonna hug hairpin turns on a stationary bike, but she kicks me out of the high-octane session.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A long-distance run, huh? Hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Runnin' slow like that's not gonna give me results. I'm gonna do things my way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next morning, I see Vodka running on the track.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka's movements seem more sluggish than usual.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Phew… What? What's with that face?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, you think I'm moving weird?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Hold on just a sec.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some rather heavy-looking weights fall from Vodka's ankles.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh. I saw this martial artist advertising these online. I thought they looked cool, so I got some of my own.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: They're pretty heavy, but you can't see 'em under my tracksuit at all, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna try wearin' these all day today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's possible they're good for her training, but Vodka's movements remain awkward and robotic all day long.
